_rule: noomesh-internal i1098, the matrix ratchet. Per fresh-install cell: the most WARN rows (verdict == "warn", controller + nodes + seats) its `noo --json cluster verify` may show, and the rows it may show them in, by the row's STABLE id from noo-cli cluster_verify/rows.rs (a reworded row keeps its id; "label" is only for people). The PR that removes a WARN lowers max_warn and drops the row. Raising is never allowed (tests/test_install_cell_ratchet.py compares this file with its version on dev); the one escape is a reviewed decision, in its own commit, adding to the cell "raise": {"from_max", "to_max", "add_rows" (ids), "reason"}. scripts/install-cell/ratchet.py judges it; a cell with "measured": null only prints a NOTE.
_fail_rule: i1098: a FAIL row always fails the cell. OFF until the release lead approves fail_allowed (0.6.28-rc.4 and 0.6.28 fresh cells showed 0 FAIL rows; 0.6.29-rc.1's cells never reached verify). Turning it on is one-way; fail_allowed only shrinks, and a row added to it needs a "why" and a reviewed "decision".
